api.definition: Application programming interface: a structured way for software to use another service, made for machines rather than humans.

er_activation.definition: The raised state of the body that comes with a strong feeling, and that the other person can see.
er_activation.example: Her activation was visible in the way she held the door open for too long.

fibre.definition: The part of food your body cannot digest. It helps your tummy work and keeps you full.
fibre.example: Wholemeal bread has more fibre than white bread.

msa_assortative_mating.definition: The pattern in which partners tend to be similar to each other on age, schooling, place or work.
msa_assortative_mating.example: Assortative mating was visible in the town: the teachers married teachers.
